title: Ruth Paine at Naushon Island retreat with Dulles's mistress
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Ruth Paine at Naushon Island retreat with Dulles's mistress, about 1963 at Naushon Island, Massachusetts, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah. No, this is correct. Um, she actually vacationed the summer of 1963 at a place called Nashon Island, which is right up near Martha's Vineyard in Massachusetts.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher who talks about the 1963 killing of President John F. Kennedy, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a woman named Ruth Paine spent the summer of 1963 on Naushon Island, near Martha's Vineyard in Massachusetts, an island tied to the Forbes family. He says she was there with Mary Bancroft, the mistress of Allen Dulles, a former head of the CIA, the US spy agency. Ruth Paine knew the family of Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of shooting Kennedy, so if true this would link Oswald's circle to the CIA's top people.
